Exercise: Seated Dumbbell Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_press

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- dumbbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- shoulder_strength_and_hypertrophy
- tricep_engagement

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Incline Seated Dumbbell Press, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders', 'triceps'], secondaryMuscles: []
- name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Press, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders', 'triceps'], secondaryMuscles: []

Substitution Options:

- name: Barbell Shoulder Press, equipment: barbell
- name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press, equipment: smith machine

Instructions:

- Grab a couple of dumbbells and sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
- Clean the dumbbells up one at a time by using your thighs to bring the dumbbells up to shoulder height at each side.
- Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
- As you exhale, push the dumbbells up until they touch at the top.
- After a second pause, slowly come down back to the starting position as you inhale.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
